annotations.title: What changed on the private credit tape

description: Dated changes by effective date (the quarter end where the change is visible) or by first-seen: new borrowers on any schedule, lenders joining and leaving facilities, facilities leaving every schedule, markdowns across lenders, PIK appearing or rising, maturities and spreads moving (observed term changes, not amendments), maturities approaching, sponsor x lender pairs forming and repeating. Routine changes (each new piece, increase, decrease, single-lender mark) only with include_routine.
